newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden to announce EMU position mid-May - Persson.
newsitem.headline: Sweden to announce EMU position mid-May - Persson.

text.p: Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson said on Monday that Finance Minister Erik Asbrink will announce Sweden's position on economic and monetary union (EMU) membership in mid-May.

"This is a question for the finance minister to speak on. I think it's a good thing for it to come from that direction first," Persson told reporters at a meeting of Social Democratic leaders on the Baltic island of Aland.
Persson said he did not believe that informal coalition partner The Centre Party would withdraw its support if the government opted for membership of EMU.

"That's inaccurate. I spoke to him (Centre Party leader Olof Johansson) earlier today and I did not get that impression," he said, when asked about reports Johansson would pull out of the informal alliance if the social democrats opted for EMU membership. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
